PROJECT_ONE_LINER: Membership dues for one cycling club, kept by one treasurer, on one Mac: who paid what, who still owes, with a history that is never lost.
STACK_SUMMARY: Node 24 · TypeScript 7 (native type stripping; `tsc` for types only) · Hono 4 + Zod 4 API on 127.0.0.1:4747 · SQLite through `node:sqlite` (one file) · React 19 + Vite 8 + React Router 8 SPA · Biome 2 · npm 11, one package
TEST_FRAMEWORK: Vitest 5 (unit + in-process API via `app.request()`) + Playwright 1.64 (one end-to-end loop, Chromium)
MIGRATION_TOOL: numbered forward-only SQL files applied by `src/server/db/migrate.ts` (ADR-003)
MIGRATION_DOWN: no down step (forward-only, ADR-003: a mistake is fixed by the next numbered file)
CHECK_PRECONDITIONS: Node ≥ 24.15 + npm 11 and `npm ci` done once; every Vitest file uses its own in-memory SQLite and Playwright starts its own server on port 4748 against a fresh temp file, so nothing is started or exported by hand
INVARIANTS:
From `DESIGN.md` §5.3, verbatim, with their `I-n` ids (each has a Vitest test of the same name, §12.2, except I-14, whose test is the Playwright request log in `e2e/sunday-loop.spec.ts`):
- **I-1** A balance is never stored; every `balance_cents` in any response was computed by §5.2.1 in the same request. No `balance` column exists in §3. Any code writing a balance column, caching a balance, or summing money in the client is a defect (ADR-016).
- **I-2** Every payment row ever inserted is readable forever; `COUNT(*) FROM payment` never decreases. (trigger 1, §3.7)
- **I-3** A `counting` payment has a membership for its `(member_id, season_id)`. (trigger 4; API `NO_MEMBERSHIP`)
- **I-4** A membership with ≥ 1 counting payment cannot be removed. (trigger 5; API `MEMBERSHIP_HAS_PAYMENTS`)
- **I-5** `amount_cents > 0` on every payment; a reduction is a correction or void, never a negative payment. (CHECK, §3.6)
- **I-6** A payment's `member_id, season_id, amount_cents, method, paid_on, recorded_at` never change after insert. (trigger 2)
- **I-7** `corrected` and `void` are terminal. (trigger 3)
- **I-8** An original is superseded by at most one correction and a correction supersedes exactly one original; `status='corrected' ⇔ superseded_by_payment_id IS NOT NULL`. (UNIQUE + CHECK, §3.6)
- **I-9** At most one season has `is_current = 1`. (partial unique index, §3.3)
- **I-10** Every season has exactly three `season_dues` rows, one per type. (`POST /api/seasons` transaction)
- **I-11** Money never moves between seasons: no query or endpoint reads payments of season A to compute anything about season B. (§5.2.1 filters on `season_id`)
- **I-12** Dues change on a season with counting payments requires `confirm.affected_memberships` equal to the live count. (§4.6, §5.3.3)
- **I-13** All money is integer cents end to end; no `REAL` column, no `parseFloat` on money outside the single UI input parser. (CHECK types, §3; Biome/grep gate §12.4)
- **I-14** The app makes no network request at run time other than to `127.0.0.1`. (§8.4; Playwright request log, §12.4)
- **§12.3** Fixtures are seeded through the API, never by raw SQL. **§12.4** No `REAL` column in `migrations/`; no `parseFloat` / `Number(` applied to money outside `src/shared/money.ts`; no SQL string built with `${` in `src/server/db/`; no identifier matching `\b(user|account|transaction|debt|fee|subscription|household)\b` in `src/` outside third-party type names (the §2.1 `Avoid` lists).
- **Reserved, never built:** no member status or `left_on` (OQ-001), no credit or carry-forward (OQ-002), no fee or charge kind (OQ-003). Code that anticipates any of them is a defect, not foresight.
ORGANISING_PRINCIPLE: A balance wrong by a single cent, or a payment that disappears, is the worst possible outcome: the treasurer goes straight back to the spreadsheet.
DB_ISOLATION: an in-memory SQLite per Vitest file (`new DatabaseSync(':memory:')`, migrated on open) and a fresh temp-file database for the single Playwright server on port 4748
DB_PARALLEL_RULE: Satisfied structurally: {{DB_ISOLATION}} gives every worker its own database, so concurrent suites cannot see each other. Nothing to check per story.
